unit: the operative sentence(s) of the clause that contain the amended words

modality.label: Duty, permission or prohibition
covers: prohibition (shall not, no person shall, prohibited)
modality.why: changes whether conduct is required, allowed or forbidden, the core of a legal instruction

penalty.label: Penalty
penalty.why: changes the consequence of non-compliance; an amount inside a penalty counts here only, never twice

threshold.label: Amount or numeric limit
covers: amounts in rupees, thousand, lakh, crore with their limit (up to, at least, fixed)
numeric limits on counts (not exceeding four, at least three members)
threshold.why: changes when the rule bites, how much is at stake, or how many are allowed

deadline.label: Deadline or period
covers: frequencies (annually, once in every N years)

exception.label: Exception or proviso
exception.why: changes who or what escapes the rule

scope.label: Scope (what the rule covers)
covers: a list item added to or removed from an enumeration
scope.why: changes what or whom the rule covers

actor.label: Person or body named
covers: a person or body (government, authority, court, officer, person, party, company, ...) named within the changed words
actor.why: changes who acts, approves or is bound (low weight: the extractor is a heuristic)

action.label: What must be done
covers: the first operative verb after the modal for a named person or body, from a fixed verb list
action.why: changes what must be done (low weight: the extractor is a heuristic)

score: sum of the weights of fields whose operation is ADDED, REMOVED or CHANGED (0-100). Fields marked UNCERTAIN are excluded and reported; the score is then a lower bound.
llm_proposals: optional; a proposed field value is used only if it validates against the schema and is a verbatim substring of the cited clause; otherwise it is discarded and the deterministic result stands
abstain_when: the clause fails the text-quality gate

not_scored_reasons.CROSS_REFERENCE_ONLY: only a cross-reference (section, clause or sub-section number) changed
not_scored_reasons.TERM_SUBSTITUTED: a term or phrase was replaced; whether this widens or narrows the rule depends on definitions this method does not compare
not_scored_reasons.UNSUPPORTED_RULE_FIELD: the changed words are outside every supported field

zero_only_when: the before and after clauses are identical after normalisation; any other change without a supported field is Not scored, never 0
changes_from_v1_1: monetary_threshold renamed threshold and extended to numeric count limits (not exceeding four)
an amount inside a penalty clause is counted once, as penalty; 'fine not exceeding' and 'fine of' are penalties
number words joined by 'and' or hyphens ('three hundred and thirty', 'twenty-one') and 'consecutive/clear/working' periods are parsed
an inserted or removed list item or Explanation is a scope change; modal verbs inside it are not counted as new duties
actor = persons or bodies named within the changed words (e.g. Tribunal -> Central Government), replacing the subject heuristic
action only from a fixed operative-verb list after the modal
a non-identical change with no supported field is Not scored with a specific reason; v1.1 could report 0 for changes outside operative sentences
